name: F. Scott Fitzgerald
bio: American novelist best known for capturing the Jazz Age. His lyrical style and sharp social observation made him one of the most celebrated writers of the 20th century.

name: Harper Lee
bio: American author whose novel To Kill a Mockingbird became a cornerstone of modern literature, exploring justice, race and moral growth through a child's eyes.

name: George Orwell
bio: English writer and essayist known for his penetrating social and political commentary. His dystopian visions remain chillingly relevant today.

name: J.K. Rowling
bio: British author who created the Harry Potter universe, one of the best-selling book series in history, translated into more than 80 languages.

name: J.R.R. Tolkien
bio: English philologist and fantasy pioneer. His legendarium, from The Hobbit to The Lord of the Rings, shaped the entire fantasy genre.

name: Jane Austen
bio: English novelist whose works of romantic fiction, witty social commentary and sharp irony earned her enduring acclaim.

name: J.D. Salinger
bio: American writer famed for The Catcher in the Rye, a landmark voice of teenage alienation and the search for authenticity.

name: Frank Herbert
bio: American science fiction author best known for Dune, a sweeping epic of ecology, politics and religion that redefined the genre.

name: Paulo Coelho
bio: Brazilian novelist whose fable The Alchemist became a global phenomenon, inspiring readers to follow their personal legend.

name: Dan Brown
bio: American author of thriller novels blending cryptography, art, history and conspiracy in fast-paced puzzles.

name: Alex Michaelides
bio: British-Cypriot author and screenwriter whose psychological thriller The Silent Patient became an international bestseller.

name: James Clear
bio: Author and speaker focused on habits, decision-making and continuous improvement. Atomic Habits is his bestselling guide to behaviour change.

name: Andy Weir
bio: American novelist known for The Martian, a hard science survival story praised for its accuracy and wit.

name: Stephen Hawking
bio: Theoretical physicist and cosmologist whose A Brief History of Time brought the mysteries of the universe to millions of readers.
